title: Lotus
description:
You can find Lotus plants in biomes with the "Snowy" tag. A Lotus grows through four stages. When fully grown you can right click it to get a Lotus Blossom, which resets the plant to its first stage. Eating a Lotus Blossom gives 3 to 11 experience.

When broken, Lotus plants will drop 1 lotus seed (at any growth stage) so you can plant them somewhere else. Lotus Seeds can only be planted on farmland (tilled soil).

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Found in Snowy biomes (world generation); no crafting recipe

properties.label: Config
properties.value: Lotus (worldgen), default true - turns world generation off

properties.label: Growth
properties.value: Grows on farmland only; needs no light or water
